notes_for_editor: Very thin: the lookout entry is one line dated only to the 1950s, so no event year is written. TopoQuest describes Coon Point as a natural cape with coordinates matching the record's to five decimals, so it is unclear whether a structure was ever built here. Two web searches found no other source on a lookout at Coon Point. The cached Forest Lookouts alphabetical list at firelookout.org/?p=1263 has no Coon Point entry. The short story is deliberate; the editor may prefer to hold it until a Forest Service or Klamath County source turns up.
